pre_required_state: PLC powered ON and network cable connected
action:
1. Verify PLC is online from HMI/SCADA communication status page
2. Check PLC heartbeat signal
expected_result:
1. PLC communication status shows Online/Connected on HMI/SCADA
2. PLC heartbeat signal is toggling
3. No communication fault alarms generated

pre_required_state: HMI/SCADA powered ON and network cable connected
action:
1. Verify HMI/SCADA is online and communicating with PLC
2. Check data exchange between HMI and PLC
expected_result:
1. HMI/SCADA displays live data from PLC
2. All screens load correctly without communication errors
3. Tag values update in real-time

pre_required_state: System healthy, no active faults, all safety interlocks satisfied
action:
1. Press Start PB from Control Panel or HMI/SCADA
2. Verify system enters auto mode
expected_result:
1. System enters auto mode
2. Green tower lamp is ON (solid)
3. Auto mode status displayed on HMI/SCADA
4. Conveyors are ready to receive commands

pre_required_state: System in auto mode or stopped
action:
1. Switch to Manual/Maintenance mode from HMI/SCADA
2. Verify mode transition
expected_result:
1. System enters manual mode
2. Amber tower lamp is ON (solid)
3. Manual mode status displayed on HMI/SCADA
4. Individual conveyor control is available

action:
1. Press any Emergency Stop button
2. Verify system response
expected_result:
1. All conveyors in associated zone stop immediately
2. Red tower lamp and reset PB lamp ON (flashing)
3. Emergency stop alarm displayed on HMI/SCADA
4. Hooter will be ON
5. ESTOP symbol displayed at respective location on HMI/SCADA

action:
1. Clear the root cause of the fault
2. Press reset button from Control Panel/HMI/SCADA
expected_result:
1. Fault disappears from alarm list on HMI/SCADA
2. Tower lamp returns to normal state
3. System is ready to restart

pre_required_state: System powered ON, all sensors connected
action:
1. Verify all sensors are detected by PLC
2. Check sensor status on HMI/SCADA diagnostics page
3. Manually trigger each sensor type to verify response
expected_result:
1. All sensors show healthy status on HMI/SCADA
2. Sensor signals correctly reflected in PLC I/O status
3. No sensor fault alarms generated

pre_required_state: System in stopped state, all safety interlocks satisfied, no active faults
action:
1. Press Start PB from Control Panel or HMI/SCADA
2. Observe startup sequence
expected_result:
1. Hooter sounds for warning period (10 sec)
2. System starts after warning period
3. Green tower lamp ON (solid)
4. All conveyors initialize in correct sequence
5. System status shows Running on HMI/SCADA

action:
1. Press System Cycle Stop from Control Panel or HMI/SCADA
2. Observe shutdown sequence
expected_result:
1. Conveyors complete current transfers before stopping
2. System stop PB ON indicating system is stopped
3. Conveyors shown Grey on HMI/SCADA
4. Green tower lamp and start PB lamp flashing if system is healthy

action:
1. Verify all safety interlocks are connected and monitored
2. Trigger each safety device individually
3. Verify system response to safety device activation
expected_result:
1. Each safety interlock correctly stops associated zone
2. Safety fault alarm generated on HMI/SCADA
3. System cannot restart until safety interlock is restored and reset

pre_required_state: System was running before power loss
action:
1. Simulate power loss by turning off main isolator
2. Wait 10 seconds
3. Restore power by turning on main isolator
4. Observe system recovery behavior
expected_result:
1. System initializes after power restoration
2. PLC restarts and establishes communication
3. HMI/SCADA reconnects and displays current status
4. System requires manual restart (does not auto-start)
5. No data corruption or incorrect states

action:
1. Disconnect communication cable between PLC and HMI/SCADA
2. Wait 30 seconds
3. Reconnect communication cable
4. Observe recovery behavior
expected_result:
1. Communication fault alarm generated on disconnection
2. System enters safe state
3. Communication re-establishes after cable reconnection
4. HMI/SCADA updates to current system state
5. System requires manual intervention to restart

action:
1. Create a fault condition
2. Check alarm history/log on HMI/SCADA
3. Clear the fault and reset
4. Verify alarm log entry
expected_result:
1. Alarm appears in alarm list with timestamp
2. Alarm details include fault description, location, and time
3. Alarm acknowledgement is logged
4. Alarm clear/reset is logged with timestamp
5. Alarm history is maintained and accessible

action:
1. Login with different user levels (Operator, Maintenance, Admin)
2. Verify access permissions for each level
3. Attempt restricted operations at lower access levels
expected_result:
1. Each user level has correct access permissions
2. Restricted operations are blocked at lower levels
3. User login/logout is logged
4. Session timeout works correctly
